messages.content: Selamat pagi. Saya Aishah, Data Protection Officer untuk eCommerce Mahkota Sdn Bhd, tenant ID `tnt-mahkota-prod`. Kami nak siapkan governance untuk campaign email Raya yang akan launch minggu depan. Boleh start dengan classify template baru kami — template ID `tmpl-raya-2026-promo-001`. Saya nak tau classification untuk PDPA risk.
Selamat pagi Puan Aishah, terima kasih kerana menghubungi data governance desk. Saya akan klasifikasikan template tersebut sekarang. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

messages.name: classify_email_template
messages.content: {"email_template_id": "tmpl-raya-2026-promo-001", "classification_id": "cls-tmpl-55001", "classified_at": "2026-05-21T09:30:11+08:00", "results": {"pii_detection": {"detected": true, "fields": ["recipient_name", "recipient_address", "order_id"]}, "sensitive_data": {"detected": false}, "marketing_intent": {"category": "promotional", "confidence": 0.98}, "jurisdiction": {"target_country": "MY", "regulation": ["PDPA-MY-2010", "MCMC-CGC"]}, "language_compliance": {"languages_used": ["ms", "en"], "prohibited_terms": []}, "overall_risk": "medium", "required_controls": ["consent_verified", "unsubscribe_link", "sender_identity", "opt_in_proof"]}}

Klasifikasi template `tmpl-raya-2026-promo-001`, Puan:
- **PII dikesan:** nama, alamat, ID pesanan
- Niat marketing: **promosi** (yakin 98%)
- Jurisdiksi: Malaysia (PDPA-MY-2010, MCMC-CGC)
- Bahasa: BM + Inggeris, tiada istilah dilarang
- **Tahap risiko keseluruhan: medium**
- Kawalan diperlukan: consent_verified, unsubscribe link, sender identity, opt-in proof

Seterusnya, kita perlu pastikan polisi governance Puan sudah ada untuk kategori promosi ini. Adakah Puan mahu saya define polisi baharu khusus untuk campaign Raya?

Yes please. Define governance policy baru — nama 'Mahkota Raya 2026 Promotional Policy', jurisdiction MY, applies to marketing. Rules: max 2 emails per recipient per week, mandatory unsubscribe, exclude minors. Sekali create rule set untuk policy ni dengan status draft.
Baik Puan, kedua-dua tindakan dijalankan secara selari.

function.arguments: {"metadata": {"name": "Mahkota Raya 2026 Promotional Policy", "description": "Governance policy for Mahkota Raya 2026 promotional email campaigns under PDPA-MY and MCMC-CGC", "jurisdiction": "MY", "applies_to": ["marketing", "promotional"], "tenant_id": "tnt-mahkota-prod", "owner": "aishah.dpo@mahkota.my"}, "rules": [{"rule_id": "r1", "label": "max_2_emails_per_recipient_per_week", "condition": {"type": "frequency", "field": "email_send_count_per_recipient_7d", "operator": "lte", "value": 2}, "action": {"type": "block_if_exceeded", "severity": "high"}}, {"rule_id": "r2", "label": "mandatory_unsubscribe_link", "condition": {"type": "content", "field": "body_contains_unsubscribe", "operator": "eq", "value": true}, "action": {"type": "block_if_missing", "severity": "critical"}}, {"rule_id": "r3", "label": "exclude_minors", "condition": {"type": "recipient_attribute", "field": "recipient.age", "operator": "gte", "value": 18}, "action": {"type": "filter_recipients", "severity": "critical"}}]}

messages.name: define_governance_policy
messages.content: {"policy_id": "pol-mahkota-raya-55001", "name": "Mahkota Raya 2026 Promotional Policy", "version": "1.0", "status": "active", "created_at": "2026-05-21T09:32:00+08:00", "rules_count": 3}

messages.name: create_governance_rule_set
messages.content: {"rule_set_id": "rs-mahkota-raya-77001", "name": "Mahkota Raya 2026 Marketing Rule Set", "status": "draft", "policy_ids": ["pol-mahkota-raya-55001"], "created_at": "2026-05-21T09:32:02+08:00"}

- Polisi `pol-mahkota-raya-55001` dicipta (3 rules, status aktif)
- Rule set `rs-mahkota-raya-77001` dibuka dalam status **draft** dan dikaitkan kepada polisi tersebut

Mohon Puan teruskan dengan langkah seterusnya. Saya cadangkan kita simulasikan kesan rule set ini pada data emel campaign lampau untuk lihat false-positive rate sebelum approve.

Bagus idea. Simulate rule set tu — proposed change set status to 'active', against last 30 days campaign data. Sekali consent profile untuk test recipient `aishah+test@mahkota.my` — marketing yes, transactional yes, profiling no.
Baik Puan, kedua-dua tindakan dijalankan secara selari.

messages.content: {"consent_profile_id": "cp-aishah-test-55001", "recipient": {"email": "aishah+test@mahkota.my"}, "status": "active", "effective_consents": {"marketing": true, "transactional": true, "profiling": false}, "updated_at": "2026-05-21T09:34:01+08:00"}

Simulasi rule set (30 hari lampau):
- Disekat: **1,248** emel
- Diluluskan: 28,412
- False positive rate: **1.8%**
- Pelanggaran tertinggi: r1 (frequency) 882, r3 (minors) 319, r2 (unsubscribe) 47
- **Status: ready_to_activate**

Profil consent test `cp-aishah-test-55001` aktif — marketing & transactional ya, profiling tidak.

Mohon Puan request kelulusan untuk activate rule set ini secara rasmi?

Yes, request approval — approver compliance director `usr-comp.director@mahkota.my`, urgency high, justification campaign Raya launches next Monday, 1.8% FP acceptable. Sekali check compliance untuk template tu dengan test recipient list 50 customer biasa.
Baik Puan, kedua-dua tindakan dijalankan secara selari.

Simulation shows 1.8% FP rate (acceptable). Rule set blocks 1248 violations in last 30 days. Need expedited approval.", "urgency": "high", "actor": {"user_id": "aishah.dpo@mahkota.my", "role": "operator", "team": "data_protection"}}

- Kelulusan `appr-rs-55-99001` dihantar kepada Pengarah Compliance, SLA 4 jam.
- Compliance check 50 recipient: **41 compliant, 9 tidak compliant** (4 melanggar frekuensi, 5 minors). ID semakan: `chk-em-55-44001`.

Mahukah Puan saya log violation rasmi dan teruskan resolve, atau tunggu kelulusan dulu?

Log violation tu dahulu — type send_to_minors, severity critical, details merujuk chk tu. Sekali resolve violations — scope hanya minors check, mitigation filter out, approver saya `aishah.dpo`. Lepas tu submit decision approval — director baru reply approve.
Baik Puan, ketiga-tiga tindakan dijalankan secara selari.

- **Violation `viol-55-88001`** direkodkan (critical, open)
- Resolusi `res-em-55-66001` selesai — 5 minors disaring, baki 45 recipient compliant
- **Rule set `rs-mahkota-raya-77001` diluluskan** oleh Pengarah Compliance (SLA dipenuhi)

Mahukah Puan saya teruskan dengan enforce polisi pada send request sebenar untuk campaign?

Yes, enforce policy pada send request. Send batch ID `batch-raya-001`, sender `marketing@mahkota.my`, scheduled send 25 Mei 9 pagi MYT, audience segment 'customers_my_active_18plus'. Sekali review violation tu — status_update to 'mitigated_under_resolution'.
Baik Puan, kedua-dua tindakan dijalankan secara selari.

Penguatkuasaan polisi pada send request:
- **Keputusan: allow_with_filter**
- Total recipient: 48,211
- Disekat (frequency r1): 412
- Disaring (minors r3): 1,882
- **Layak hantar: 45,917 recipient**
- Penghantaran dijadual 25 Mei 9:00 pagi MYT

Violation `viol-55-88001` kini berstatus **mitigated_under_resolution**.

Adakah Puan mahu saya jadualkan job retention untuk emel campaign ini supaya selepas tempoh tertentu, data recipient akan dipadam mengikut polisi?

Yes please. Schedule retention job — type purge_email_engagement_data, scope batch `batch-raya-001`, retention 180 days dari send date. Sekali subscribe team `dpo-team@mahkota.my` ke notifikasi rule set events.
Baik Puan, kedua-dua tindakan dijalankan secara selari.

- Snapshot `snap-rs-55-77001` direkodkan (simpanan 3 tahun).

One more. Customer mintak data export PDPA right of access — subject `cust-mahkota-77881`, email `siti.nur@gmail.com`. Categories profile, consent_history, email_engagement, format json. Delivery via secure download link. Requested by saya.
